'''Thermosensitive blankets''' were a variety of [[Blanket/Legends|blanket]] that were used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the years leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] made use of one such blanket while on [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].<ref name="TAS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
